source.repro: `estimatedBytesForRegions` from `@gmod/bam` on `ctgA` of each file, at spans from 1kb to 20kb. The sub-floor rows are flat across that whole range, which is the point: below one linear-index bin the estimate stops moving.
source.notes: What SUB_FLOOR_BYTE_BUDGET_FACTOR is sized against. The deepest file here needs 2x to clear BAM's 5 Mb adapter limit at gene scale: 7.44 Mb against 5 becomes 7.44 against 10.
